planner_finish.summary: SOLVED in one episode (no reset). task_language: "put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it". Perception-first: agentview hi-res identified the grey patterned/yellow-rim bowl semantically (vs the wine bottle) and region back_projection gave the open bottom drawer's fibre-board cavity (floor z=0.924, x[-0.074,0.097], y[0.088,0.217]); wrist was used only for geometry. pi0_pick("pick the bowl") lifted it at the rim (verified by gripper_qpos ~0.002 pinch + empty table spot in wrist), set_gripper +1 firmed the grip, then I scripted the whole carry with gripper=+1: re-measured the held-mug-style offset after a rotate_wrist(-1.57) (offset rotated to ~(-0.05,0) world x), lifted to z=1.17 first to clear the drawer front, hopped to (0.05,0.145,1.16), slow-descended to z=1.03 and released 5 cm above the drawer floor with the bowl centre ~0.14 in y (z-band probe confirmed the bowl interior at z=0.953 over the 0.924 floor). pi0_doubled("close the bottom drawer of the cabinet") slid the drawer in (front panel 0.06->0.204) but terminated stayed false; comparing our handle y=0.181 against the two closed sibling handles (0.198/0.221) showed the drawer was ~2-3 cm short of seated, and my own move_to could not reach down there (IK near the reach limit), so after move_pose(target_pitch=0,target_yaw=0) restored the standard gripper a second pi0_doubled close-pass seated it fully. The predicate registered on the next env steps: terminated=true, task_success=true at step 20. Audit and recipe written to the online-task dir.
